cues.en: Billions. Because if I have a T-shirt, it's worth nothing. Or it's worth the materials that it costs to make it.

cues.en: It's pretty weird. So that logo's worth a lot, but the logo's just a part of their brand.

cues.en: Right? So that illustration could've been something else. I'm pretty sure we'd pay the same amount.

cues.zh: 你知道这一点，因为迈克尔·乔丹有他的Jumpman球鞋，那是一个不同的标志。
cues.en: And you know that, because when Michael Jordan has his Jumpman shoe, it's a different mark.

cues.zh: 而现在那非常值钱。
cues.en: And that now is worth a lot.

cues.zh: 那么，为什么有些人能为此收1倍价钱，有些收10倍，甚至100倍？这些公司之间的差别是什么？
cues.en: Ok, so, why is it that some people can charge 1x for that, 10x for it, and 100x. What's the difference between those companies?

cues.en: Why is that?

cues.zh: 对客户的价值
cues.en: Value to client

cues.zh: 这很重要，对吧？对客户的价值。那么，这是一个客户。
cues.en: That's important. Ok? The value to the client. So, uh, this is one client.

cues.zh: 假设那是一条裙子。那是一家小本经营的家庭企业，所以对他们来说，那个价值就“一般般”。
cues.en: Let's assume that's a skirt. That's a mom and pop business, so, that value to them is 'meh.'

cues.zh: 对吧？而另一边是某种大型企业。
cues.en: Ok? And on the opposite side of this is some kind of giant corporation.

cues.zh: 所以在这两者之间的某个地方，那么……
cues.en: So somewhere between here, so...

cues.zh: 在座的每个人想必都足够有才华，肯定能画出这个标志。
cues.en: Everybody here presumably is talented enough to draw this logo, for sure.

cues.zh: 但取决于你把它给谁，价格就应该不同。
cues.en: But depending on who you give it to, the price should change.

cues.zh: 所以现在，我们不是在按时间收费，而是在按价值收费。
cues.en: So then now we're not charging for time. We're charging for value.

cues.zh: 有件事你得知道，因为我跟一些在Landor and Associates工作过的人聊过。
cues.en: Here's one thing that you need to know, because I talked to some of the guys that worked over at, uh, Landor and Associates.

cues.zh: 他们设计过一些全球最大的品牌。Fedex、Cincos，嗯，H&R Block。
cues.en: They designed some of the worlds biggest brands. Fedex, Cincos, um, H&R Block.

cues.zh: 他们一个logo收一百万美元。
cues.en: They get a million dollars a logo.

cues.zh: 明白吗？绿色方块
cues.en: Ok? Green square

cues.zh: 但这是个不错的绿色方块。当logo效果不好时，他们要面对的是：风险。
cues.en: But it's a good green square. What they have when the logo doesn't work well is: They have risk.

cues.zh: 明白吗？Uber就遭遇过反弹。人们把logo换回去了，他们经历了所有这些麻烦，所以这里面风险很大。
cues.en: Ok? Uber had a backlash. People revert their logos, and they went through all this stuff, so, there's a lot of risk involved.

cues.zh: 明白吗？然后他们还有实体的东西需要把logo放上去。
cues.en: Ok? And then they have physical things that they need to put the logo on.

cues.zh: 这要花很多钱。所以他们会随便找个不入流的公司来给他们做logo吗……
cues.en: It costs a lot of money. So are they going to hire some rinky-dink operation to create a logo for them...

cues.zh: ……当他们得花上亿美元，去重新印刷飞机、所有宣传册，以及这个东西触及的一切？
cues.en: ...when they have to spend hundreds of millions of dollars, to reprint the airplanes, all the brochures, everything that this thing touches?

cues.zh: 永远。很长很长的时间。
cues.en: Forever. For a long, long time.

cues.zh: 那可是一笔昂贵的开销。
cues.en: That's an expensive proposition.

cues.zh: 所以你会想向他们收更多的钱。
cues.en: That's why you would want to charge them a lot more.

cues.zh: 所以你不能一上来就说个固定数字。你要按客户定价，而不是按工作定价。
cues.en: So you don't go into it saying it's the flat number. You price the client and not the job.

cues.zh: 价值是什么？对吧？
cues.en: What's the value? Ok?

cues.zh: 一个标志……你们说 ROI 的时候：我不喜欢这个说法，因为这个标志本来可以是任何样子，对他们来说价值还是一样的。
cues.en: A logo...When you guys say ROI: I don't like that because this mark could've been anything and it would still be as valuable to them.

cues.zh: 所以严格来说它不会有正面的商业影响，但它可能有非常负面的商业影响。
cues.en: So it doesn't technically have a positive business impact but it could have a really negative business impact.

cues.zh: 如果人们讨厌它。如果它看起来像巨大的生殖器符号。有时候这些东西确实会这样，对吧？
cues.en: If people hate it. If it looks a giant, phallic symbol. Which sometimes these things do, right?

cues.zh: 所以这就是它可变的原因。
cues.en: So that's why its variable.

cues.zh: 对我来说，嗯，我有这么个原则：一个项目我必须收一定金额的钱。
cues.en: Now, for me, um, I have this thing where I need to charge a certain amount of money for a project.

cues.zh: 否则我就没法对它感兴趣，因为你看这个空间，是一栋大楼。我得付很多人的工资。
cues.en: Otherwise, I can't be interested in it because if you look at this space it's a big building. I gotta pay a lot of people.

cues.zh: 电费。光是维持经营就得花不少钱，所以我知道每个月只能接这么多活……
cues.en: Electricity. It costs a lot of money just to be in business, so I know I can only manage so many jobs per month...

cues.zh: ……所以单凭我的经营成本，我的报价一开始就会比你高得多。
cues.en: ...so just by virtue of what it costs for me to do business, my rates are going to begin much higher than yours.

cues.en: Ok, so, what do we charge here?

cues.en: We charge anywhere from twenty to fifty thousand to do the strategy before we draw the logo.

cues.en: Ok? We charge another ten to write messaging.

cues.en: And we charge another ten, or so, to do the applications, depends on what they ask for.

cues.en: The applications typically are three things. I say pick three.

cues.en: Right? So it's gonna be a business card...

cues.en: I'm writing a little fast and sloppy here. I'm sorry.

cues.en: Is that straight, at least? Business card, what else do they want?

cues.zh: 信头纸！谢谢，Matt。
cues.en: Letterhead! Thanks, Matt.

cues.en: Letterhead...email blast.

cues.en: Huh? Brand guides is included in this.

cues.en: In this, yea. The usage guide is included in there.

cues.en: It's a template we have. It's pretty easy. We just knock it out.

cues.en: That's what we charge to do a logo.

cues.zh: 但你怎么拆分呢？比如 logo，是统一一口价，还是有客户经理介入、按小时收费？
cues.en: But how do you break it down? Like for the logo, is it just like flat rate, or do you have like, account executives that go in and they charge their hours?

cues.zh: 不不不。我不按小时收费。大概会是这样，好吧？
cues.en: No, no, no. I don't do hourly. It'll look something like this, ok?

cues.en: Line item number 3: Logo

cues.en: You're gonna have three rounds. Ok?

cues.zh: 就这样。
cues.en: That's it.

cues.zh: 其他项目我有更多词可以用，但logo……我不知道还能用什么。
cues.en: The other ones I have more words to use, but the logo...I don't know what else to use.

cues.zh: 好，那当你把这个给客户看时，他们不在意吗？他们不会说：“你花了多少小时？多少——？”
cues.en: Ok, so when you show that to your client, they don't care? They don't go: "How many hours did you put it?How many--?"

cues.zh: 不会。好。当有人说：“多少小时？我要看明细。会计需要知道。多少小时的工作量？”你该怎么说？
cues.en: No. Ok. What should you say when somebody says: "How many hours? I need to see the breakdown. The accountants need to know. How many hours of work?

cues.zh: 你会怎么说？
cues.en: What are you gonna say?

cues.zh: 嗯，我们不是按小时收费，但……什么回应比较好？除了说：“不，滚蛋。”
cues.en: Well, we don't charge hourly but...what's a good response? Besides saying: "No, F-U."

cues.zh: 什么回应比较好？
cues.en: What's a good response?

cues.zh: 我会问他们：“你投入多少小时——或者我们投入多少小时——重要吗？还是你能从中获得的价值更重要？”
cues.en: I'd ask them: "Does it matter many hours you put in--or we put in--or does it matter the value you're gonna get out of it?"

cues.zh: 那有时候会变得挺复杂，他们会说：“不，我们就想知道。”
cues.en: Well then, sometimes it can get pretty sophisticated and they're like: "No, we wanna know."

cues.zh: 对吧？对吧！？他们不会就这么说：“行吧，你赢了！”
cues.en: Right? Right!? They don't just say, like: "Ok, you win!"

cues.zh: 还有别人……你以前有过这种对话吗？
cues.en: Does anybody else...have you had that conversation before?

cues.zh: 没有，我没有过。
cues.en: No, I haven't.

cues.zh: 好吧
cues.en: Ok

cues.zh: 我觉得这就是再次给他们报出自身价值时的那份底气。就像如果你要付这么多钱，你就能得到这么多小时，或者我这么多的投入。
cues.en: I guess it's that confidence of giving them their value again. Like if you're gonna pay so much, you're gonna get this many hours, or this amount of my effort.

cues.zh: 所以我觉得这就是那份底气：“啊，我就收你18，因为你知道我有经验，我们在赢，我们有这样那样的东西。
cues.en: So I guess it's that confidence of: "Ah, I'm just gonna charge you 18 because you know I have experience and we're winning and we have whatever.

cues.zh: 你知道，所有这些都能撑得住。你明白我的意思吗？
cues.en: You know, all this to back it up. Do you see what I'm saying?

cues.zh: 我明白你的意思。
cues.en: I get what you're saying.

cues.zh: 所以这里有个底气的问题。能够走进房间说：“就是这个数。我就是这么干的。这就是我们的规矩。”
cues.en: So theres an issue of confidence. To be able to walk into the room and say: "That's the number.That's how I work. That's our policy."

cues.zh: 我们就是这么干的。所以这里有个底气的问题。
cues.en: That's how we work. So there's this issue of confidence.

cues.zh: 你知道 Paul Rand 吗？就是那个著名的 Paul Rand。我记得他设计一个 logo 收费大概一百万美元。
cues.en: Do you know Paul Rand? Famous Paul Rand. I think he charged like a million dollars for a logo.

cues.zh: 他大概是这么说的：“有时候我要花两周，有时候要花一年。等我准备好了，我自然知道。回头见。”
cues.en: He's like: "Sometimes it takes me two weeks. Sometimes it takes a year. I'll know when I'm ready. I'll see you in a little bit."

cues.zh: 他就是这么干的！
cues.en: That's how he did it!

cues.zh: 他从不为此道歉。接着说！
cues.en: He's not apologizing. Go ahead!

cues.zh: 我一直很喜欢 Paula Scher 那个城市 logo 的典故，她真的就是在会上随手画在鸡尾酒餐巾纸上的，当时他们正在讨论想要什么样的设计……
cues.en: I always liked the Paula Scher reference with the city logo, where she literally drew it on a cocktail napkin in that meeting where they were going over what they were looking for...

cues.zh: ……然后他们报了个价，客户有点怀疑，她说：
cues.en: ...and they charged a certain price, and the client was skeptical and she's like:

cues.zh: “不，就是这样！logo 就在这儿！你刚刚就画出来了。你只用了三十秒。”
cues.en: "No, that's it! That's the logo right there! You just did it. It took you thirty seconds."

cues.zh: 她说：“嗯，画这三十秒，靠的是花了我六位数学费的教育，和三十四年的经验。”
cues.en: And she's like: "Well it took an education that cost me 6 figures and 34 years of experience to draw that in 30 seconds."

cues.zh: 对，对。
cues.en: Right, right.

cues.zh: 你付的不是时间钱，你付的是——
cues.en: You're not paying for time. You're paying for---

cues.zh: 毕加索有个更好的说法，不过没错，是同一个意思，对吧？
cues.en: Picasso had a better version of that, but yes. That's the same idea, right?

cues.zh: 我画成这样没花10秒，花了一辈子。
cues.en: It didn't take me 10 seconds. It took me a lifetime to draw like this.

cues.zh: 好吗？
cues.en: Ok?

cues.zh: 各位，是这样的：我喜欢争论，我喜欢辩论。
cues.en: So look guys. Here's the thing: I like to argue. I like to debate.

cues.zh: 好吗？所以我可以从好几个角度来辩这个事。
cues.en: Ok? So I can debate this a number of different ways.

cues.zh: 那你们想辩论——你们想更互动一点吗？你们想先互相辩论吗？
cues.en: So should you guys arg--Do you guys want it to be more interactive? Do you guys wanna argue with each other first?

cues.zh: 还是你们想怎么来？或者你们就想要答案，然后咱们散会？
cues.en: Or how do you want to do this? Or do you just want the answer and let's go home?

cues.zh: 那——那——那是——那是……
cues.en: Wha--wha--what's that--what's the...

cues.zh: （笑声）
cues.en: (Laughter)

cues.zh: 你们还挺在意幻灯片的哈？就像：“叮！”
cues.en: You care about the slides huh? It's like: "Ding!"

cues.zh: 好，那我直接给你们答案。你们想怎样都行。我可以角色扮演。我们可以抛接球。想干什么都行，好吗？
cues.en: Ok, I'll just give you the answer. I can do anything you guys want. I can roleplay. We can juggle. We can do whatever you want, ok?

cues.zh: 好，Jung，给我一个假设的时薪。
cues.en: Alright. Jung, give me a hypothetical hourly rate.

cues.zh: 不一定是你的，但给我一个时薪。
cues.en: It doesn't have to be yours but give me an hourly rate.

cues.zh: 希望是18的倍数，好吗？
cues.en: Hopefully divisible by eighteen, ok?

cues.zh: 什么？
cues.en: What?

cues.zh: 200块一小时……
cues.en: 200 bucks an hour...

cues.zh: 好，200块一小时。Rosille，那是90小时吗？
cues.en: Ok, 200 bucks an hour. Rosille, is that 90 hours?

cues.zh: 谁来算一下？是吗？200块一小时乘以90小时。
cues.en: Somebody? Yeah? 200 bucks an hour times 90 hours.

cues.zh: 好，那么，Jung，你来当客户。
cues.en: Ok, so, Jung, you be the client.

cues.zh: 我来当Jung。好吗？拿话筒。
cues.en: I'll be Jung. Ok? Take the mic.

cues.zh: 我会跟你争论。
cues.en: I will argue with you.

cues.zh: 好吗？这是第一招。我不喜欢这招，但我现在就对你用。
cues.en: Ok? Here's tactic number 1. I don't like this tactic but I'll use it with you right now.

cues.zh: Jung，你准备好了吗？
cues.en: Jung, are you ready?

cues.zh: 你是客户，我是你。
cues.en: You're the client, and I'm you.

cues.zh: 好，准备好了吗？不，不。你想知道我的时薪？
cues.en: Ok, you ready? No, no. So you wanna know my hourly rate?

cues.zh: 所以我的时薪是这个乘以这个。
cues.en: So my hourly rate's this times this.

cues.zh: 那么客户，我有个问题问你。
cues.en: So I have a question for you, client.

cues.zh: 你为什么想知道我的时薪？
cues.en: Why do you wanna know my hourly rate?

cues.zh: 我想知道我那1万8千美元花到哪去了。
cues.en: I guess I wanna know where my eighteen thousand dollars is going.

cues.zh: 那是不是说，如果我工作时间少，就该少收你钱？
cues.en: Ok, so does that mean if I work less hours, I should charge you less?

cues.zh: 对。
cues.en: Yea.

cues.zh: 那如果我超过这些工时，就该多收你钱？
cues.en: So if I go over those hours, I should charge you more?

cues.zh: 当然。
cues.en: Sure

cues.zh: 真的？
cues.en: Really?

cues.zh: 真的！
cues.en: Yea!

cues.zh: 好，那你的意思是：你觉得这个logo花的时间越长越好，而不是越短越好？
cues.en: Ok, so, you're saying to me: You value this logo taking longer rather than shorter?

cues.zh: 也就是说：要是我告诉你这logo我做了4个月，你现在就欠我三万六千美元。
cues.en: So it means: If I just tell you it took me 4 months to work on it, you will now owe me thirty-six thousand dollars.

cues.zh: 如果在我预算内，而且我觉得你值这个价。但我也会问：做个logo为什么要那么久？
cues.en: If it's in my budget and if I think you're worth it. But i would also ask: Why would it take that long to make that logo?

cues.zh: 我想投入很多心血。
cues.en: I wanna put a lot of effort into it.

cues.zh: 但我可以雇别人，收费一样，但做得更快。
cues.en: But I could hire somebody else that would charge me the same rate but be quicker.

cues.zh: 那你就是更看重时间，而不是钱？
cues.en: So you value time over money then?

cues.zh: 当然，作为生意人，是的。
cues.en: Sure, as a business person, yeah.

cues.zh: 那这么着吧：我干活特别快。我能做出logo，但我却因为效率高、做得好而受罚。
cues.en: So here's the deal: I work really fast. I can come up with a logo, but I'm being punished for me being efficient and really good.

cues.zh: 你明白吗？现在这套逻辑行不通了。
cues.en: Do you understand? The logic doesn't work now.

cues.zh: 问题就在这儿。
cues.en: That's the problem.

cues.zh: 所以客户不能两头都占。
cues.en: So clients can't have it both ways.

cues.zh: 他们不能说：“告诉我需要多少小时，但你不能超。”
cues.en: They can't say: "Tell me how many hours, but you can't go over it."

cues.zh: 我没法给它设上限。逻辑上必须对称。
cues.en: I can't put a cap on it. It has to have some symmetry to the logic.

cues.zh: 所以如果我做得少，你就想付我更少。
cues.en: So if I work less, you want to pay me less.

cues.zh: 那现在可以类推的地方就很多了。
cues.en: So then there's a lot of analogies that you can draw now.

cues.zh: 大多数商人都看重时间。
cues.en: Most business people value time.

cues.zh: 还记得我们谈话开头说的吗？
cues.en: Remember at the beginning of our talk?

cues.zh: 时间是我最重要的东西。就这个。
cues.en: Time is the most important thing I have. That's it.

cues.zh: 所以如果我现在就能给你做个logo，你五分钟就喜欢上了，你是说它比18小时还不值？
cues.en: So if I can do a logo for you right now and you love it in 5 minutes, are you saying it's worth less than 18?

cues.zh: 还是说现在更值了？因为我帮你省了大把时间。
cues.en: Or is it worth more now? Because I saved you a lot of time.

cues.zh: 我们现在就能推向市场。
cues.en: We can go to market right now.

cues.zh: 它更值！
cues.en: It's worth more!

cues.zh: 所以按小时收费，是在惩罚我干得好。
cues.en: So charging by the hour punishes me for being good.

cues.zh: 我跟你说：你可以雇四个刚毕业的实习生。总共花个几百块，然后你就等着吧。
cues.en: Now I'll tell you what: You can hire four interns straight out of school. They'll charge a couple hundred bucks total, and you'll wait.

cues.zh: 然后你会说这不对，但你又说不清楚，他们也不知道为什么。
cues.en: And then you'll say it's not right, but you can't articulate to them and they don't know why.

cues.zh: 你就一直等，一直改，那你现在没在做的是什么？
cues.en: And you keep waiting and you keep revising and what aren't you doing now?

cues.zh: 你没在经营你的生意，Jung。
cues.en: You're not running your business, Jung.

cues.zh: 你不该专注于你的生意吗？
cues.en: Shouldn't you be focused on your business?

cues.zh: 所以我的工作是这样的，Jung：我要给你一个很棒的标志，让你很长时间都不用换。
cues.en: So my job is this, Jung: I'm gonna give you an amazing logo that you're not gonna have to change for a long time.

cues.zh: 一个你会引以为傲的标志；人们一看就能清楚明白你是做什么的。
cues.en: A mark that you're going to be proud of; That people are going to look at and clearly understand what it is that you do.

cues.zh: 这值一万八千美元。
cues.en: That's worth eighteen thousand dollars.

cues.zh: 今天。
cues.en: Today.

cues.zh: 一年后再来找我，就是两万六了。
cues.en: Come back to me in a year. It'll be twenty-six.

cues.zh: 这就是它今天的价值。
cues.en: That's what it's worth today.

cues.zh: 就是这样。
cues.en: That's it.

cues.zh: 所以你在——基本上，你是在给自己赋值。
cues.en: So you're putting--Basically, you're putting value to yourself.

cues.zh: 赋予你作为设计师的价值。
cues.en: To what you're worth as a designer.

cues.zh: 其实，我这个定价完全是基于你。
cues.en: Well, I'm basing this price just on you, actually.

cues.zh: 如果你更有名气，这个数字只会更高。
cues.en: If you were bigger, that number would just go up.

cues.zh: 不，我的意思是你在试图——你在为这一万八千美元的价值辩护或争论，说你要做的事……
cues.en: No, but what I'm saying is that you're trying to--You're defending or arguing the value of eighteen thousand dollars by saying that what you're going to do...

cues.zh: ……或者说你工作的价值值一万八千美元，因为它实在太出色了，好太多了。
cues.en: ...or your value of your work is worth eighteen thousand dollars because it's so amazingly good; So much better.

cues.zh: 所以，你是在试图抬高——
cues.en: So, you're trying to elevate--

cues.zh: 我这么说了吗？
cues.en: Did I say that?

cues.zh: 某种程度上，是的。
cues.en: In a way, yeah.

cues.zh: 好吧。那是你说的，不是我说的。
cues.en: Ok. Then you said it and not me.

cues.zh: 对，所以，这就是——作为客户我在想——
cues.en: Right, so, that's what--As a client I'm thinking that--

cues.zh: 那是你在想的？！
cues.en: That's what you're thinking?!

cues.zh: 是的。
cues.en: Yeah.

cues.zh: 那我们刚才到底做了什么？
cues.en: So what did we just do here?

cues.zh: 所以，Frank Shih。当我向他推销我更好、值得这一切时，他不会相信我。
cues.en: So Frank Shih. When I sell him that I'm better and worth all this stuff, he's not gonna believe me.

cues.zh: 我想我没说过那些话。我们可以回放录音。
cues.en: I didn't say any of those words, I think. We can replay the tape.

cues.zh: 我不认为我说过那些话，但Jung这么认为，因为我很自信，而且我这样呈现出来。
cues.en: I don't believe I said any of those words, but Jung thinks that, because I'm confident and I'm presenting it like this.

cues.zh: 对，是自信，但你也在比较两者，因为你在说：“如果我们有三个实习生，那要花很长时间——”
cues.en: Right, it's confidence, but you're also comparing the two because you're saying: "If we have three interns that will take forever--"

cues.zh: 所以你在提升价值。不仅是工作质量的价值，还有——我想——工作效率的价值。
cues.en: So you're building up the value. The value of not only the quality of your work, but also the--I guess--the efficiency of your work, as well.

cues.zh: 所以你有点在给你做的事情赋予很多价值。
cues.en: So you're kinda putting a lot of values to what you're doing.

cues.zh: 我想是这样。我想是这样。
cues.en: I think so. I think so.

cues.zh: 不妨试试这个想法：逻辑的对称性。
cues.en: Just try this idea out for size: Symmetry of logic.

cues.zh: 如果它在设计中是这样运作的，那它在我们生活的其他地方也是这样运作的吗？
cues.en: If it works like this in design, does it work like this somewhere else in our life?

cues.zh: 找个例子。
cues.en: Look for an example.

cues.zh: 比如你要去度假，或者出去吃晚饭，希望回家时家里一尘不染。
cues.en: So you're gonna go on vacation, or you're gonna go out for dinner, and you want the house to be spotless by the time you get back.

cues.zh: 你在意的是什么？是你回来之前活儿干完了。
cues.en: What do you value there? That the job gets done by the time you're back.

cues.zh: 这对你很重要。我有个朋友，自己开了家设计公司，他……你知道的……
cues.en: That's important to you. Now my friend, um, who owns his own design agency and he's...you know...

cues.zh: 他是个大人物。他说过类似这样的话。我不觉得你能用这招，但他用，因为他敢说，行吧？
cues.en: ..he's a big deal. He said something like this. I don't believe you can use this, but he uses it, because he can say it, ok?

cues.zh: 他说：“你喜欢耐克吗？”
cues.en: He says: "Do you like Nikes?"

cues.zh: 你喜欢耐克吗，Jung？
cues.en: Do you like Nikes, Jung?

cues.zh: 不太喜欢。
cues.en: Not really, no.

cues.zh: 你就配合一下嘛！
cues.en: Just play a-freaking-long!

cues.zh: 好吧好吧，我喜欢耐克！
cues.en: Ok, ok, I like Nikes!

cues.zh: 他根本不懂这些套路怎么玩。对，你喜欢耐克，值七百美元呢。
cues.en: He doesn't understand how these games work. Yeah, you like Nikes. They're worth seven hundred dollars.

cues.zh: 你在乎那双鞋是怎么做出来的吗？
cues.en: Do you care how those shoes are made?

cues.zh: 你在乎有个小孩只拿五十美分就在做这活儿吗？
cues.en: Do you care that there's some kid, who's paid fifty cents, to work on that?

cues.zh: 你在意吗？
cues.en: Do you care?

cues.zh: 你只在意它们是Nike。
cues.en: You just care that they're Nikes.

cues.zh: 对吧？
cues.en: Right?

cues.zh: 这就是逻辑的对称性。
cues.en: That's symmetry of logic, there.

cues.zh: 你在意的是最终产品，是高质量的产品，符合你的期望。
cues.en: What you care about is the end product, that is a high quality product, and it lives up to your expectations.

cues.zh: 他这么说了。所以他让他们滚蛋。
cues.en: So he says that. So he tells them to F-off.

cues.zh: 他确实这样。我和他有过很多商业对话。
cues.en: He does. I've had lots of business conversations with him.

cues.zh: 他疯得离谱！
cues.en: He's craaazy!

cues.zh: ……但他很有效。
cues.en: ...but he's effective.

cues.zh: 嗯，好，那我回到这边的图，Nike是1倍、10倍、100倍……
cues.en: Um, ok, so I'm going back to the drawing right over here where Nike is 1x, 10x, 100x...

cues.zh: ……从小作坊到大公司给客户带来的价值……
cues.en: ...value to the client from a mom and pop versus a large coorporation...

cues.zh: 对！
cues.en: Yes!

cues.zh: ……我衡量价值的方式是，呃，增加利润或降低风险。
cues.en: ...and the way I measure value is by, uh, increasing profit or reducing risk.

cues.zh: 对吧？
cues.en: Right?

cues.zh: 不，我没提利润。
cues.en: No, I didn't mention profit.

cues.zh: 你只是在降低风险。
cues.en: You're just reducing risk.

cues.zh: 只是降低风险，好。
cues.en: Just reducing risk, ok.

cues.zh: 是的，你也可以这样看：这个标志会触及多少东西？
cues.en: Yes, and you could also look at it like this: How many thing will this logo touch?

cues.zh: 你印刷吗？你的印刷预算是多少？
cues.en: That you print? What is your printing budget?

cues.zh: 是4000万美元。好吧，我不会收你2000美元。
cues.en: It's 40 million dollars. Well, I'm not gonna charge you 2,000 dollars.

cues.zh: 顺便说一句，你不会得到这份工作的。
cues.en: You won't get the job, by the way.

cues.zh: 如果你在那个项目上报价过低，他们会非常害怕。
cues.en: If you under bid that project, they'll be really scared.

cues.zh: 所以你可以问他们：“你们的印刷预算是多少？这个标志会涉及多少东西？”
cues.en: So you can ask them: "What's your printing budget? How many things does this mark touch?"

cues.zh: 如果出了问题会怎样？
cues.en: What happens when this goes wrong?

cues.zh: 所以在他们心里，他们会想：“天哪，你说得对。”
cues.en: So, in their mind they're like: "Oh my god. You're right."

cues.zh: 所以你可以花更少的钱雇人——
cues.en: So you can hire somebody for less money--

cues.zh: 所以，在你提供服务并报价之前，你就已经获得了大量信息，你获取了所有信息并在脑中计算……
cues.en: So, you're getting a ton of information before you even offer a service and price and you're getting all the information and doing the math in your head...

cues.zh: ……最终产品会给他们带来什么，这样你就能看出它会有多大的价值。
cues.en: ...of what the end product is gonna render them so you could see what kind of value it's gonna have.

cues.zh: 我不是在脑子里算，我是和你现场一起算。
cues.en: I don't do it in my head, I do it live with you.

cues.zh: Sean，这东西我们要印多少份？巴拉巴拉巴拉。
cues.en: Sean, how many things are we gonna print this on? Bla bla bla bla.

cues.zh: 你的印刷预算呢？比如，天哪，你觉得该花多少？我就是试着让他们自己说出来。
cues.en: What's your printing budget? Like, oh my gosh, what do think you should spend? I just try and get them to say it.

cues.zh: 你们看出这里的主题了吗？我想在这里来个元时刻，拜托。
cues.en: You guys see the theme here? I just wanna do like a meta moment here, please.

cues.zh: 元时刻就是：我不想说。
cues.en: Meta moment is: I don't wanna say it.

cues.zh: 我就想一直问你问题，直到你说出来。
cues.en: I just wanna ask you questions until you say it.

cues.zh: 等你自己说出来了，你才会相信。
cues.en: When you say it, you believe it.

cues.zh: 你们明白吗？因为每次这样争，你都会输。
cues.en: You guys understand that? 'Cuz you'll lose this fight every single time.

cues.zh: 我就问一堆问题。继续吧。
cues.en: I just ask lots of questions. Go ahead.

cues.zh: 好，现在我来唱反调——抱歉——这位，呃，年轻女士——
cues.en: So alright, now playing devil's advocate--I'm sorry--This um, young lady--

cues.zh: Amy Gooseman
cues.en: Amy Gooseman

cues.zh: Amy！好，我在跟你聊，我已经和Amy聊过了，我在Instagram上关注了她，还在跟她所有的内容互动……
cues.en: Amy! Ok, so I'm talking with you, I've already talked with Amy, I followed her on Instagram and I'm engaging with all her stuff...

cues.zh: ……我看到她的互动量很不错，因为她确实是个很棒的平面设计师……
cues.en: ... and I see her engagement is doing well because she's a really great graphic designer...

cues.zh: 是的。
cues.en: Yea.

cues.zh: ……所以现在我来找你，她给我报价一千五百美元……
cues.en: ...and so now I'm coming to you, and she quoted me fifteen hundred dollars...

cues.zh: 嗯。
cues.en: Right

cues.zh: ……现在我来找你，你说要一万八千美元，但我看到——我想弄清楚，因为我知道她做得非常好。
cues.en: ...and now I'm coming to you and you're saying eighteen thousand dollars but I'm seeing--I'm trying to figure out because I know she does really great work.

cues.zh: 我是说，差别在哪，因为我觉得她做得很好。她的互动量很高。我想看看她怎么会是风险更大——风险大那么多的人选；要付一万八千美元。
cues.en: I mean what's the difference, 'cuz I feel that she does great work. She gets a lot of engagement. I'm tryna see how she would be a risker--that much of a riskier person to go with; To pay eighteen thousand dollars.

cues.zh: 好，嗯……
cues.en: Ok, um...

cues.zh: 我要问你几个问题。
cues.en: I'm gonna ask you a few questions.

cues.zh: 这个logo对你的生意重要吗？
cues.en: Is the logo important to your business?

cues.zh: 呃，是的。
cues.en: Uh, yeah.

cues.zh: 好，那它就有意义。所以如果做对了：你就能继续推进你的生意。如果做错了：你就得把这个流程重做一遍。
cues.en: Ok, it means something. So if it's right: You can move on with your business. If it's wrong: You have to redo this process again.

cues.zh: 对吗？
cues.en: Is that right?

cues.zh: 没错。
cues.en: Correct.

cues.zh: 所以我明白，选错供应商是有风险的。
cues.en: So I understand there's some risk associated with picking the wrong vendor.

cues.zh: 你会用什么标准来判断这个供应商是否适合你？
cues.en: What criteria would you use to determine if it's a good vendor for you or not?

cues.zh: 嗯，我想是证明吧。
cues.en: Um, I guess proof.

cues.zh: 证明？那对你来说什么算证明？
cues.en: Proof? So what's proof to you?

cues.zh: 呃，案例研究……
cues.en: Uh, case studies...

cues.zh: 案例研究。Amy的案例研究比我们多吗？
cues.en: Case studies. Does Amy have more case studies than us?

cues.zh: 呃，没有。
cues.en: Uh, no.

cues.zh: 好，你下一个标准是什么？
cues.en: Ok, what's your next thign?

cues.zh: 呃，我还在衡量哪些其他标准——
cues.en: Uh, what other criteria am I gauging--

cues.zh: 对。
cues.en: Yes.

cues.zh: 嗯，就这些了！我只想知道她以前做过什么。
cues.en: Um, that's it! Just, I wanna know that what shes done before.

cues.zh: 想想风险。
cues.en: Think about the risk.

cues.zh: 好。
cues.en: Ok.

cues.zh: 像客户那样思考。别像设计师那样想，要像客户那样想。
cues.en: Think like a client. Don't think like a designer, think like a client.

cues.zh: 你做这行多久了？有多少推荐客户？你的信用记录怎么样？
cues.en: How long have you been in business? How many referrals do you have? What's your credit story like?

cues.zh: 我想看看你的办公空间。你有多少员工？
cues.en: I wanna see your office space. How many employees work for you?

cues.zh: 而所有这些方面，理论上我都能胜过Amy。
cues.en: And for all those things, theoretically, I can beat Amy on.

cues.zh: 你可以选择冒险，也可以不冒。
cues.en: So you can take risk or not.

cues.zh: 你是赌徒吗？
cues.en: Are you a gambler?

cues.zh: 所以如果你不能——
cues.en: So if you can't--

cues.zh: 嗯？
cues.en: Huh?

cues.zh: 所以对我来说——显然我没有Blind那样的公信力——所以我不可能处在同一个……同一个量级……
cues.en: So for me--which I don't have the credibility, obviously, that Blind does--so I wouldn't be able to be in the same...in the same ballpark figure...

cues.zh: ……就像我连想都不敢想接近的数字。
cues.en: ...as like I can't even think about anything close.

cues.zh: 不，你可以的！
cues.en: No you can!

cues.zh: 我现在就告诉你们一件事：
cues.en: Here's the thing I'm gonna tell you guys right now:

cues.zh: 你们现在都能做到。大家总以为因为我是这个人，我做过这些事，我拿过这些奖……
cues.en: You could all do this right now. Everybody always thinks because I'm this person and I've done this and I have these awards...

cues.zh: 不，那不重要，因为在我刚起步的第一天，我就想收这样的价格了。
cues.en: No, it doesn't matter because the first day I started, I wanted to charge these rates anyways.

cues.zh: 我当时就已经是那样工作的。
cues.en: I was already working like that.

cues.zh: 明白吗？你只需要能把它说出口，因为我第一次为策略收一万美元的时候……
cues.en: Ok? You just have to be able to say it out of your mouth because the first time I charged ten thousand dollars for strategy...

cues.zh: ……那是我第一次为战略咨询收一万美元。
cues.en: ...was the first time I charged ten thousand dollars for strategy.

cues.zh: 我没有先收一百，然后两百，再两百五。
cues.en: I didn't do it for a hundred, and then two hundred, and two-fifty.

cues.zh: 我直接就上去了。
cues.en: I just went for it

cues.zh: 他们付钱的时候我心想：“哇，这真不错。我得为战略咨询收两万美元！”
cues.en: And when they paid I was like: "Huh, this is really good. I need to charge twenty thousand dollars for strategy!"

cues.zh: 我们就是这么把这些价码一步步抬上去的。
cues.en: And that's how we keep getting these things up.

cues.zh: 后来我发现有些傻子收一百万美元。我心想：“我到底哪里不对劲？我本可以收更多！”
cues.en: And then I find out some other fools charge a million dollars. I'm like: "What is wrong with me? I could charge more for this!"

cues.zh: 就这样。你只需要相信它就值这个价。
cues.en: That's it. You just have to believe that this is what it's worth.

cues.zh: 而且这必须与公司所承担的风险相对应。
cues.en: And it has to be relative to the risk to the company.

cues.zh: 我不管你是谁。你可能是 Paul Rand，你想是谁都行——他已经不在了——
cues.en: I don't care who you are. You can be Paul Rand, You can be anybody you want--He's not alive anymore--

cues.zh: 小客户来找他，他为了一个三明治就干了……
cues.en: Mom and pop comes to him, he's gonna do it for a sandwich...

cues.zh: ……因为对他们来说，它就值这个价。
cues.en: ...because that's what it's worth to them.

cues.zh: 明白吗？客户不会选最好的选项，他们选风险最低的选项。
cues.en: Ok? Clients don't choose the best option. They choose the least risky option.

cues.zh: 你得让自己看起来是风险最低的那个。
cues.en: You need to appear as the least risky thing.

cues.zh: 所以直接问他们：“你们做决定用的是什么标准？”
cues.en: So just ask them: "What criteria are you using to make your decision?"

cues.zh: 这你应该早就知道了。我知道……
cues.en: You should already know this. I know it...

cues.zh: 他们会查信用记录，还想看你的推荐人。
cues.en: They run credit history checks. They wanna see your refferals.

cues.zh: 明白吗？社会认同非常重要。
cues.en: Ok? Social proof is really important.

cues.zh: 他们想知道你是专家。
cues.en: They wanna know that you're an expert

cues.zh: 你知道吗？我 literally 写过一本关于品牌的书——就在那儿。
cues.en: Well, you know what? I wrote the book, literally, on brand--There it is.

cues.zh: 我教别人怎么做这个，也做咨询。
cues.en: I teach and consult people how to do this.

cues.zh: 我不会那么说。
cues.en: I don't say it like that.

cues.zh: （笑声）
cues.en: (Laughter)

cues.zh: 我本人比这友好多了。
cues.en: I'm much friendlier in person.

cues.zh: Rossille，你想说什么？
cues.en: Rossille, what do you wanna say?

cues.zh: 我们是不是该弄清楚——以及怎么弄清楚——一家公司的营收是多少？
cues.en: Should we be finding out--and how do you find out--what a company's revenue is?

cues.zh: 你想让我来做这个？很简单
cues.en: You want me to do that? It's really easy

cues.zh: 这对你们很重要吗？了解公司的收入情况？
cues.en: Is that important to you guys? To understand revenue of the company?

cues.zh: 你可以猜，也可以问，但人们不太可能直接告诉你。
cues.en: You can make guesses, you can ask, but people are not likely to tell you that.

cues.zh: 有些设计师犯的错误是，他们只想直奔终点，试图弄清楚公司的价值。
cues.en: Some designers make the mistake that they just wanna cut to the end and try and find out what the company's worth.

cues.zh: 这是一种比较迂回的方式，让客户更自在，一步步把财务信息透露给我。
cues.en: This is kind of a roundabout way that makes it a little bit more comfortable for the client to share and disclose financial information to me in small steps.

cues.zh: 我喜欢和客户交谈，让他们明白我是个懂商业概念的生意人。
cues.en: I like to engage in conversation and to establish with the client that I'm a business person that understands business concepts.

cues.zh: 你怎么了解资金情况？
cues.en: How do you find out about money?

cues.zh: 你怎么了解资金情况？
cues.en: How do you find out about money?

cues.zh: 所以你知道，当我去找我的财务顾问时，他说：“你们赚多少钱？”
cues.en: So you know when you--When I went to my financial adviser he's like: "How much money do you guys make?"

cues.zh: 哇！我——我是说我们才刚认识！先握个手吧？这是怎么回事？好吗？
cues.en: Woah! I-- I mean we just met! Like, do I get a handshake first? What's going on here? Ok?

cues.zh: 我做事的方式比较绕。
cues.en: I have a round and about way of doing it.

cues.zh: 你得开始了解他们的业务。
cues.en: And you have to start to understand their business.

cues.zh: 告诉我你是怎么生成——Rosille！
cues.en: Tell me how you generate--Rosille!

cues.zh: 你又变回你的客户了。选一个你非常了解的客户。你得相当了解他们的业务。
cues.en: You're your client again. Pick a client that you know really well. You have to know their business quite well.

cues.zh: 好，我想了解你们是怎么创造收入的。
cues.en: Ok, so I wanna understand how you guys generate revenue.

cues.zh: 好吗？因为我相信其他那些设计师会给你做出很漂亮的东西，但我真正想帮你的是增加收入。
cues.en: Ok? Because I believe those other designers are going to make you some really nice things, but I actually want to help you increase revenue.

cues.zh: 增加收入对你们公司重要吗？
cues.en: Is increasing revenue important to your company?

cues.zh: 当然。
cues.en: Ofcourse.

cues.zh: 奇怪的是，有些人会说“不重要”。
cues.en: Some people say no, oddly enough.

cues.zh: 有些人会说不重要。我不知道为什么。
cues.en: Some people say no. I don't know why.

cues.zh: 增加收入：那么你们今天是怎么创造收入的？
cues.en: Increasing revenue: So how do you generate revenue today?

cues.zh: 你们有多个业务方向吗？有电商网站吗？比如，你们怎么赚钱？
cues.en: Do you have multiple skews? Do you have an e-commerce site? Like, how do you make money?

cues.zh: 呃，我们有个电商网站，产品也卖给医生诊所。
cues.en: Uh, we have an e-commerce site, and we sell out products and physician's offices.

cues.zh: 好，电商。你们做过直销吗？
cues.en: Ok. E-commerce. Do you ever sell direct?

cues.zh: 其他方式呢？还是通过销售代表？
cues.en: Other ways? Or through sales reps?

cues.zh: 嗯……目前没有，但我们在考虑开始一个——
cues.en: Hmm...Not at the moment, but we're thinking of starting a--

cues.zh: 请给我几个类别。
cues.en: Give me a couple categories, please.

cues.zh: 因为如果只有一个，那进展就太快了。
cues.en: Because if it's just one, it's kind of really fast.

cues.zh: 好吧，电商，我是说直接面向患者，对，通过那个——
cues.en: Ok, well E-commerce, I mean, direct to patients, yeah, through the--

cues.zh: 但通过他们的电商门户？
cues.en: But through their e-commerce portal?

cues.zh: 不，不，不。是在诊所里。
cues.en: No, no, no. In the offices.

cues.zh: 比如整形外科。
cues.en: Like plastic surgery.

cues.zh: 好，那我们会把这更多看作零售……
cues.en: Ok, so we would consider that more of a retail..

cues.zh: 零售，对。
cues.en: Retail, yeah.

cues.zh: 好，零售。好，还有什么？
cues.en: Ok, retail. Ok, what else?

cues.zh: 目前，那就是——好吧。嗯，我想你可以说……
cues.en: Right now, that's--Well ok. Um, I guess you could say...

cues.zh: 比如说他们也有销售代表。
cues.en: Let's say they have reps too.

cues.zh: 是的，销售代表。
cues.en: Yeah,reps.

cues.zh: 好，就说销售代表吧。好。
cues.en: Ok, let's say reps. Ok.

cues.zh: 好的，完美。
cues.en: Alright, perfect.

cues.zh: 现在我要请你……呃……现在帮我做两件事。
cues.en: And now I'm gonna ask you just to...to uh...do two things for me right now.

cues.zh: 第一：就做你自己，扮演客户。同时也要做那个观察自己、理解自己感受的人。
cues.en: One is: Just be who you are, playing the client. And also be the person looking at you and understanding how you feel.

cues.zh: 你能做到吗？
cues.en: Can you do that?

cues.zh: 再说一遍。
cues.en: Say that again.

cues.zh: 好，就是在跟我说话的时候，要觉察自己的情绪，好吗？
cues.en: Ok, to be aware of your emotions while you're talking to me, ok?

cues.zh: 因为待会儿我会问你几个相关问题。所以我得现在告诉你，不然你会一脸懵：“啊？我没注意啊。”
cues.en: 'Cuz later on I'm gonna ask you a few questions about that. So I have to tell you now 'cuz otherwise you'll be like: "Huh? I wasn't paying attention to that."

cues.zh: 到目前为止还好吗？
cues.en: So far, so good?

cues.zh: 好，那么电商、零售和销售代表。你们是国际销售，还是全部国内？
cues.en: Ok, so e-commerce, retail, and reps. Do you sell internationally, or is it all domestic?

cues.zh: 呃，也做国际。
cues.en: Um, internationally too.

cues.zh: 好，那你们也有国际销售代表？
cues.en: Ok, so you have international reps too?

cues.zh: 应该是吧……
cues.en: I believe so...

cues.zh: 配合一下就行。我们不是在核实事实。
cues.en: Just play along. We're not fact checking.

cues.zh: 当然，加拿大。
cues.en: Sure, Canada.

cues.zh: 国际代表。好的。
cues.en: International reps. Ok.

cues.zh: 好的，这些每一项分别占你们年总收入的百分之多少？
cues.en: Alright, what percentage of your overall revenue per year do each one of these represent, percentage wise?

cues.zh: 好的，很棒！你们做得真不错！
cues.en: Ok great! You're doing really well!

cues.zh: 零售占另外30%？
cues.en: Retail would be another 30?

cues.zh: 好吧，这说不通。
cues.en: Ok, that's not gonna make sense.

cues.zh: 对，所以我才写了数字“2”，但你打断了我。
cues.en: Yea that's why I did the number "2" but you stopped me from doing that.

cues.zh: （笑声）
cues.en: (Laughter)

cues.zh: 对，电商算45吧。
cues.en: Yea do e-commerce at 45.

cues.zh: 对。你知道这些数字都是编的吧？
cues.en: Yea. You know these are just made up numbers?

cues.zh: 只要加起来等于一百，我们就信你。
cues.en: As long as it equals a hundred, we believe you.

cues.zh: 零售算25，然后剩下的随便分。
cues.en: Retail at 25 and then just split the rest.

cues.zh: 你现在对我太抠细节了，拜托！
cues.en: Now you're just being too granular with me, come on!

cues.zh: 好……二十五……那就是七十。
cues.en: Ok...twenty-five...that's seventy.

cues.zh: 然后代表算10%，国际算20%。
cues.en: And then do reps at ten percent and international at twenty.

cues.zh: 好，好。
cues.en: Ok, ok.

cues.zh: 现在加起来是一百了吧，各位？好，那么：
cues.en: Now, that equals a hundred, right guys? Ok, now:

cues.zh: 这些东西每一项的利润率是多少？
cues.en: What are your profit margins on each one of these things?

cues.zh: 它会来到这儿，直接溜进来，你们甚至都不会察觉。
cues.en: It's gonna come here. It's gonna slip right in. You guys won't even know it.

cues.zh: 这占了你们收入的45%。既然你们是直销，利润空间会非常高。
cues.en: So this represents forty-five percent of your revenue. Since you're selling direct, your profit margins are gonna be very high here.

cues.zh: 没有中间商。
cues.en: There's no middle man.

cues.zh: 如果进货价是一美元，零售商从你这儿拿货是五毛。
cues.en: If this costs a dollar to buy, the retailer bought it from you for fifty cents.

cues.zh: 那你得用两毛五造出来才能活下去。
cues.en: So you have to make it for twenty-five cents in order for you yo survive.

cues.zh: 这叫双基石定价，每层翻一倍。
cues.en: It's called the double keystone. It doubles each time.

cues.zh: 明白吗？零售一美元，批发五毛，制造——也就是成本——成本价两毛五。
cues.en: Ok? At retail, it's a dollar, at wholesale, it's fifty cents, and manufacturing--that's cost--at cost, it's twenty-five cents.

cues.zh: 这个你懂了吧？
cues.en: So you understand that?

cues.zh: 所以当你没有中间商、直接销售时……
cues.en: So when you have no middle man and you're direct...

cues.zh: 这就是为什么Apple账上有数万亿美元现金，因为他们自己制造，直接卖给你。
cues.en: This is why Apple has trillions of dollars in cash because they make it and they sell it directly to you.

cues.zh: 我们知道电商的百分比是多少吗？你觉得你的利润率是多少？
cues.en: What do we know the e-commerce percentage to be? What do you think your profit margin is?

cues.zh: 所以这就是为什么在座的各位缺乏商业意识，会在这种对话中吃亏。
cues.en: So this is where everybody's lack of business sense here is gonna hurt you in this kind of conversation.

cues.zh: 你确实需要了解一些商业基础知识，我们会讲到这个，好吗？
cues.en: You do need to know some business fundamentals and we will talk about it, ok?

cues.zh: 你想一想，你赚一块钱，成本是二十五美分。这个最高能是多少？
cues.en: Well, you think about a dollar and it costs you twenty-five cents to make it. What's the highest this can be?

cues.zh: 不，不可能。你不可能做到百分之百的利润。
cues.en: No, it cannot be. You cannot make a hundred percent profit.

cues.zh: 百分之七十五！最高只能是百分之七十五的利润。
cues.en: Seventy-five! The highest it can be is seventy-five percent profit.

cues.zh: 对吧？因为成本占了百分之二十五。
cues.en: Right? 'Cuz it costs you twenty-five percent to make it.

cues.zh: 所以不会是百分之七十五；还有其他成本在里面。
cues.en: So it's not gonna be seventy-five percent; There's some other costs in there.

cues.zh: 好吗？所以假设大概是，嗯，百分之六十五的利润。
cues.en: Ok? So lets say it's like, um, sixty-five percent profit.

cues.zh: 好吗？我们这里要讲的是毛利润。
cues.en: Ok? And we're gonna talk about gross profit here.

cues.zh: 我们说的不是净利润，这个我稍后会讲。
cues.en: We're not talking about net profit and I'll get into that later.

cues.zh: 所以这是你收入的45%，毛利润的65%。
cues.en: So this is 45% of your revenue, 65% gross profit.

cues.zh: 零售的话，假设是进店销售，你的利润率大概会是这样。
cues.en: When you're selling to retail, assuming that it's in the store, what's your profit margin gonna be like this?

cues.zh: 什么？有人在算数呢！百分之二十五。对！
cues.en: What? Somebody is doing their math! Twenty-five percent. Right!

cues.zh: 因为你得以五十美分卖出去，所以最多也就百分之二十五。
cues.en: 'Cuz you had to sell it for fifty cents, so the best that it can do is twenty-five percent.

cues.zh: 明白吗？如果你做得对，就是25%。
cues.en: Ok? If you're doing your job right, its 25%.

cues.zh: 然后是经销商。经销商是什么？批发商。他们卖给零售，所以情况会非常相似。明白吗？
cues.en: And then the reps. The reps are what? A wholesaler. They sell to retail, so it's going to be very similar. Ok?

cues.zh: 而国际经销商通常想要更多的钱，因为你还是个没被验证的东西，他们得做所有的营销和所有辛苦的工作。
cues.en: And international reps generally want even more money from you because you're an unproven thing and they have to do all the marketing and all the hard work.

cues.zh: 可能低到20%。
cues.en: It might be as low as 20%.

cues.zh: 好的，客户女士：从营销/品牌推广计划的角度来看，我们最应该把精力集中在哪个领域？
cues.en: Ok, Miss Client: What area of this seems to make the most sense to focus our efforts in terms of marketing/branding initiative.

cues.zh: 哪里？
cues.en: Where?

cues.zh: 给我建个网站！
cues.en: Build me a website!

cues.zh: 嗯，这里。很明显。就在这里。
cues.en: Well, here. It's obvious. It's right here.

cues.zh: 这已经是你收入中最大的一块了，而且你在这里赚的利润最多。
cues.en: Already, this is the biggest portion of your revenue, and you make the most profit in here.

cues.zh: 所以你们这些做网站的人……答案几乎总是这里。
cues.en: So you guys that build websites...almost always the answer is here.

cues.zh: 直接销售。
cues.en: Sell direct.

cues.zh: 不过，大多数客户的收入并没有45%来自这里。比这低得多……
cues.en: Now, most clients don't have 45% of their revenue. It's much lower than this...

cues.zh: ……因为他们不擅长建网站，也不是靠这个起家的。
cues.en: ...'cuz they're not good at building websites and it's not where they're set up.

cues.zh: 他们是从这里起步的。所以这里大概会占80%，而这里大概只有5%。
cues.en: They started here. So this will be like 80% and this will be like 5.

cues.zh: 通常情况是反过来的。
cues.en: It's usually opposite.

cues.zh: 对吧？好，那么如果我们能推动这个指标——我们做得很好，快进到年底：
cues.en: Ok? Alright, so if we're able to move the needle--we do really well, fast forward to the end of the year:

cues.zh: 从45%能提升多少个百分点？你觉得是多少？
cues.en: How much percent increase can we go from 45? What do you think it is?

cues.zh: 我们希望能把它提升多少？
cues.en: How much can we hope to boost this up?

cues.zh: 罗西尔？
cues.en: Rosille?
At least 20%.

cues.zh: 不，那太慷慨了！天哪！
cues.en: No, that's too generous! Oh my god!

cues.zh: 不。大概2%、3%。他们不会说25%，因为那是荒谬的增长！
cues.en: No. Like 2, 3%. They're not gonna say 25% 'cuz that's rediculous growth!

cues.zh: 对吧？如果我们今年做得非常好，可能能提高5%，达到50%。
cues.en: Right? If we can do really well in this year we might get this up to 5% higher, up to 50%.

cues.zh: 那就说提高5%，好吗？
cues.en: So let's say it's 5% higher, ok?

cues.zh: 所以我们要把45加上5%。
cues.en: So we're gonna increase 45 plus 5%.

cues.zh: 好，让我在这里澄清一点。
cues.en: Alright let me clarify something right here.

cues.zh: 当我问客户这个举措会对他们公司产生多大影响时……
cues.en: When I'm asking the client about how much impact the initiative will have on their company...

cues.zh: ……我其实是想确定我所做的事情的真正价值。
cues.en: ... I'm really trying to ascertain what the real value of what it is that I'm doing.

cues.zh: 不是我所投入时间的价值，而是客户将获得的净结果价值。
cues.en: Not the value of the time that I put into it, but the net value of the result that clients are going to get.

cues.zh: 现在大多数设计师倾向于以定性的方式思考设计或解决方案。
cues.en: Now most designers tend to think about design or solutions in a qualitative way.

cues.zh: 看起来更好、更贵、更奢华、更高端。
cues.en: Like it looks better, it's more expensive, it's more luxurious, it's more premium.

cues.zh: 这些都是定性层面的东西。
cues.en: Those are qualitative things.

cues.zh: 但当我从定量角度看，比如我们要把百分比从2%提高到4%……
cues.en: But when I look at a quantitative thing in terms of we're gonna raise percentage from 2% to 4%...

cues.zh: ……我们要把200万美元的业务转化成400万美元的业务。
cues.en: ...We're gonna convert on 2 million dollars of business to 4 million dollars of business.

cues.zh: 所以本质上，我是在客户心中建立起一个认知：我们要做的事值200万美元。
cues.en: So in essence, then, I'm establishing in the client's mind that what we're going to do is worth 2 million dollars.

cues.zh: 那对你来说，这相当于多少营收？
cues.en: What is that to you in terms of revenue?

cues.zh: 税前利润呢？这对你来说是多少？
cues.en: Before profit? What is that to you?

cues.zh: 哦，是2000万美元。现在我知道了。
cues.en: Oh, it's 20 million dollars. Now I know.

cues.zh: 所以我拿这个数字乘以20，就知道你是一家4亿美元规模的公司。
cues.en: So I take that number times 20 and I know you are a 400 million dollar company.

cues.zh: 看出我是怎么算出来的了吗？
cues.en: See how I figured that out?

cues.zh: 关键是：我不需要做那些复杂的数学……
cues.en: Now here's the thing: I don't have to do the fancy math...

cues.zh: ……因为一旦我用商业语言和另一位商业人士交流，他们就会很自然地跟我谈数字。
cues.en: ...because once I talk business to another business person, they feel comfortable talking to me about the numbers.

cues.zh: “哦，Chris，我们一年做800万美元的生意，还有这个数字！我们不需要关注那个。”
cues.en: "Oh, Chris, we do 8 million dollars a year and this numbers that! We don't need to focus on that."

cues.zh: 我就说：“太好了，我也是这么想的。”
cues.en: I'm like: "Great, that's what I thought."

cues.zh: （音乐）
cues.en: (Music)

cues.zh: 但问题是：我帮助他们在过程中意识到需要把精力集中在哪儿。
cues.en: But the thing is: I helped them to realize in the process where they need to focus their energy.

cues.zh: 好，大家看这个。如果我们把业务增长5%，那将等于2000万美元的收入，好吧，按65%的毛利率算。
cues.en: Ok so look at this, guys. If we increase business 5%, it's gonna equal 20 million dollars in revenue, ok, at 65% gross margins.

cues.zh: 65%……不管那个数字是多少……都是一大笔钱。至少是1000万。大概是1200万左右，对吧？
cues.en: 65%...whatever that number is...it's a lot of money. It's at least 10 million. It's probably something like 12 million, ok?

cues.zh: 所以如果我们修好网站，你就有可能获得1200万的净利润——呃，毛利润——1200万美元。是这样吗，客户女士？
cues.en: So if we fix the website, you stand to gain a net profit of 12 million--Uh, gross profit--12 million dollars. Is that true, Miss Client?

cues.zh: 我们该花多少钱来搭建这个全新的超棒电商平台呢？
cues.en: What kind of money should we spend in building this new amazing e-commerce platform?

cues.zh: 如果你要赚1200万美元的毛利，那我们该花多少钱来建一个更好的网站？
cues.en: If you're gonna make gross profit of 12 million dollars, what kind of money should we spend to build a better site?

cues.zh: 它值多少？
cues.en: What's it worth?

cues.zh: 不惜一切代价。
cues.en: Whatever it takes.

cues.zh: 差不多，但说个具体数字！
cues.en: Kinda, but throw out a number!

cues.zh: 嗯……对，大概就其中的10%。
cues.en: Um...yeah, like 10% of that.

cues.zh: 10%？10%。那我们就花120万美元给你建个新网站。
cues.en: 10%? 10%. So let's spend 1.2 million dollars to build you a new website.

cues.zh: 你乐意吗？
cues.en: Are you cool?

cues.zh: 我乐意。
cues.en: I'm cool.

cues.zh: 这儿有谁建网站？
cues.en: Who here builds a website?

cues.zh: 好，我打给Sean。我雇Sean来——你收多少钱？
cues.en: Ok, I'm gonna call Sean. I'll hire Sean for--What do you charge?

cues.zh: 不是那个数。
cues.en: Not that

cues.zh: 我知道，但你就随便说个数字！
cues.en: I know, but just throw something out!

cues.zh: 你会收我多少？“Sean，我有个活儿。大客户。你会收我多少？”
cues.en: What would you charge me? "Sean I got a job. Big client. How much would you charge me?"

cues.zh: 就今天，现在，对，对！
cues.en: Today right now, yeah, yeah!

cues.zh: 6000美元。我付给Sean 6000美元，他会乐坏了，而我就赚这中间的差价。
cues.en: 6,000 bucks. I'm gonna pay Sean 6,000 dollars, he's gonna be thrilled with that, and I will make the difference between these two.

cues.zh: 就这么回事。
cues.en: That's all it is.

cues.zh: 哦，我说……他们会付我120万美元。我是个创业者。我会找人把它做出来。
cues.en: Oh, I say...they're gonna pay me 1.2 million dollars. I'm an entrepreneur. I'm gonna find somebody to make it.

cues.zh: 我认识的最优秀的人。我会付全价。
cues.en: The best person I know. I'm gonna pay the full rate.

cues.zh: 不还价，我付你全价。
cues.en: No negotiation, I'm gonna pay you full rate.

cues.zh: 那是傻子才给的价格。
cues.en: It's a fool's rate.

cues.zh: （笑声）
cues.en: (Laughter)

cues.zh: 差价我来补。
cues.en: And I make the difference.

cues.zh: Gabriel。
cues.en: Gabriel.

cues.zh: 那么，嗯，现在我是客户了。你怎么保证我的5%增长？
cues.en: So, um, now I'm the client. How can you guarantee my 5% increase?

cues.zh: 我保证不了。我没向你保证过。我只是问你一个问题。
cues.en: I can't. I did not guarantee you that. I just ask you a question.

cues.zh: 可是……我不是……
cues.en: Well but I'm...I'm not...

cues.zh: 我没法向你保证。
cues.en: I can't guarantee you that.

cues.zh: ……我不相信做这个网站就能带来5%的增长。
cues.en: ...I'm not convinced that making the website will be up 5%.

cues.zh: 那你觉得什么数字能让你满意？
cues.en: Well, what number would make you happy?

cues.zh: 什么是现实的目标？既不过于乐观，也不过于悲观。
cues.en: What's a realistic goal? Not an optimistic and not a pessimistic goal.

cues.zh: 那……可是……如果客户……客户从来没这么反问过你吧？
cues.en: So...but...but...what would you say if a client...a client's never said that back to you?

cues.zh: 他们在会上问过这个问题吗？我们怎么能保证这一点？
cues.en: Did they ask that question in a meeting? How come we can guarantee this?

cues.zh: 我无法保证结果。
cues.en: I cannot guarantee results.

cues.zh: 那么，如果这又是风险的问题。
cues.en: So then, if that's the risk thing again.

cues.zh: 想要保证的话，我得收你300万美元。
cues.en: If you want a guarantee I'm gonna charge you 3 million dollars.

cues.zh: 我给你一个保证。
cues.en: I'll give you a guarantee.

cues.zh: 你会吗？
cues.en: You will?

cues.zh: 我会！我就……我把费率提到三倍。
cues.en: I will! I'll just...I triple the rate.

cues.zh: 300万，我给你一个保证。300万美元我能搞定，我挺有把握的。
cues.en: I'll give you a guarantee for 3 million. I can figure it out for 3 million dollars, I'm pretty sure.

cues.zh: 那要是涨不到5%，你就把那300万退回来？
cues.en: And then if it doesn't go up 5% you'll give the 3 million back?

cues.zh: 什么？等等，打住。那边笑声太大了！怎么回事？
cues.en: What? Wait. Hold on. There's too much laughter on that side! What's that?

cues.zh: 要是涨不到5%，你就把那300万退回来？
cues.en: If it doesn't go up by 5% you'll give the 3 million back?

cues.zh: 对啊！保证不就是这个意思吗？
cues.en: Yeah! That's what a guarantee is right?

cues.zh: 没错，我为我的工作负责。
cues.en: Yeah, I stand behind my work.

cues.zh: 那你凭什么觉得它一定会涨？
cues.en: And why do you think that it will?

cues.zh: 因为我厉害啊。因为到时候我会雇Al Martinez帮我做数据分析。
cues.en: Because I'm good. 'Cuz then I'm gonna hire Al Martinez to do the data analytics for me.

cues.zh: 我要雇三个Sean。把你们最好的本事拿出来。咱们好好研究研究，把这事搞明白。
cues.en: I'm gonna hire 3 Seans. Gimme the best work you guys. Let's study this thing. Let's figure it out.

cues.zh: 我们可以调整。你们可能不知道，我是摩羯座……
cues.en: We can tweak. You know....you guys don't know this but I'm a Capricorn...

cues.zh: ……这意味着我信奉持续改进。这是我的心理医生告诉我的。
cues.en: ...which means I believe in constant improvement. That's what my therapist told me.

cues.zh: 一直在不断地改进。
cues.en: Constantly improving all the time.

cues.zh: 在一定时间内提升5%是非常可行的。
cues.en: A 5% increase over a certain period of time is very doable.

cues.zh: 所以我打算这么做：我会让我的律师起草一份东西。
cues.en: So here's what I'm gonna do: I'll have my attorney draft up something.

cues.zh: 你让你的律师看看，看看合不合格之类的，如果没问题，我们就往下推进。
cues.en: You have your attorney look at it. See if it passes mustard, whatever, and if it's good, then we move forward.

cues.zh: 不过我要说的是：咱们定一个现实的时间表。如果我做到一半，我就拿一半。
cues.en: Here's what I'm gonna say though: Let's give it a realistic time table. If I hit half, I make half.

cues.zh: 因为任何大于0的百分比都是赚的。钱进你口袋，对吧？
cues.en: 'Cuz anything percentage over 0 is better. It's money in your pocket, right?

cues.zh: 所以如果我今天就给你这个提议：你给我50美分，我给你1美元。
cues.en: So if I gave you this offer today: If you give me 50 cents, I give you a dollar.

cues.zh: 你会做这笔交易吗？
cues.en: Would you do that deal?

cues.zh: 是的。
cues.en: Yes.

cues.zh: 如果我说：你给我75美分，我给你1美元。你会做这笔交易吗？
cues.en: What if I said: You give me 75 cents, I'll give you a dollar. Would you do that deal?

cues.zh: 你当然会！那是25%的回报率！
cues.en: Of course you would! That's a 25% return on your money!

cues.zh: 你现在存银行能拿多少，大概0.01%？
cues.en: What are you getting in the bank right now, like .01%?

cues.zh: 25%……我在拉斯维加斯问过一群人……他这么说：“不。不。得看情况。”
cues.en: A 25%...I asked this question in Las Vegas to a crowd...he's like: "No. No. It depends."

cues.zh: 我说：“看什么情况？看你疯没疯？看你还有没有气？”
cues.en: I'm like: "It depends on what? If you're crazy? If you're still breathing?"

cues.zh: 你为什么不做？所有创业者都信这个。
cues.en: Why wouldn't you do that? All entrepreneurs believe in that.

cues.zh: 我们总是把钱存进银行，就为了那一点点百分比。
cues.en: We put our money into the bank all the time to make a tiny little percentage.

cues.zh: 我们指望股市给我们4%、5%、6%的回报。
cues.en: We hope the stock market gives us a 4, 5 , 6% return.

cues.zh: 如果我让你花75美分赚1美元——也就是25%的回报，或者说不管具体是多少，这算法不太对，但……
cues.en: If I tell you to spend 75 cents to make a dollar--which is 25% return, or whatever it is, that's not the right math, but...

cues.zh: ……那对你来说是有价值的！
cues.en: ...that's valuable to you!

cues.zh: 我相信我能推动这个。我会按比例算给你！
cues.en: I believe I can move this. I'll pro-rate this!

cues.zh: 这交易怎么样？
cues.en: How's that for a deal?

cues.zh: 好交易。
cues.en: Good deal.

cues.zh: 我现在就能告诉你，这是最有价值的事情之一。
cues.en: one of the most valuable things, I can tell you right now.

cues.zh: 你们推销自己做的事，我推销世界能做的事。
cues.en: You guys sell what you do. I sell what the world can do.
